title: Appraisal Order Complexity Add-On: Site Part
content:
### Site part of the Appraisal Order complexity add-on

**Clause.** The site part of the complexity add-on reads the site size the Appraisal Order report states, counted as no site at all when the property type on the Mortgage Loan File the order supports is a condominium: a site of 3 acres or more adds 80 dollars, a site of 1 to under 3 acres adds 40 dollars, and a smaller site adds nothing. The site part is added into the add-on subtotal of the complexity add-on.

**Condition and result.**

| Property type on the loan file | Site the report states | Site part (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Not a condominium | 3.00 acres or more | 80.00 |
| Not a condominium | 1.00 acre to under 3.00 acres | 40.00 |
| Not a condominium | Under 1.00 acre | 0.00 |
| Condominium | Any size | 0.00 |

**Boundary readings (hypothetical sites, not a condominium).** 0.99 acres adds nothing; 1.00 acre adds 40.00; 2.99 acres adds 40.00; 3.00 acres adds 80.00. A condominium file with a stated site of 4.50 acres adds nothing.
